parsed_json.sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cr.compound_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM chembl_id_lookup cil JOIN compound_records cr ON cr.doc_id = cil.entity_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON md.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = md.molregno WHERE cil.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1123890' AND cil.entity_type = 'DOCUMENT' AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id, cr.compound_name, cs.canonical_smiles
